section: Special Assistance Package vs Special Category Status - Government's stand and measures taken
subsections: Measures taken - SPV route, releases, NITI Aayog and Finance Ministry roles

accepted.s: Which Union Ministry operates the Scheme for Special Assistance to States for Capital Investment (SASCI)?
o: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
accepted.x: The Ministry of Finance operates SASCI. The scheme provides assistance to States for capital investment.
accepted.tq: Use the ministry-ownership trap by matching the scheme with the correct administrative authority.
accepted.sec: Measures taken - SPV route, releases, NITI Aayog and Finance Ministry roles

accepted.s: SASCI assistance is provided outside which fiscal limit associated with the Sixteenth Finance Commission?
o: The 3 per cent of GSDP fiscal-deficit ceiling
The 2 per cent of GSDP revenue-deficit ceiling
The 4 per cent of GSDP primary-deficit ceiling
The 5 per cent of GSDP debt-servicing ceiling
accepted.x: SASCI assistance is outside the Sixteenth Finance Commission's 3 per cent of GSDP deficit ceiling.
accepted.tq: Split the options by identifying the precise percentage and the type of fiscal limit involved.
accepted.sec: Measures taken - SPV route, releases, NITI Aayog and Finance Ministry roles

accepted.s: SASCI was introduced in which month and year?
accepted.tq: Use the close-year numerical trap and select the exact commencement date.
accepted.sec: Measures taken - SPV route, releases, NITI Aayog and Finance Ministry roles

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the role of line ministries under SASCI?
o: They administer the Sixteenth Finance Commission's deficit ceiling.
They decide the constitutional status of Andhra Pradesh.
They replace the Ministry of Finance as the borrowing authority.
They run sub-schemes under the assistance framework.
accepted.x: Line ministries run sub-schemes under SASCI. They do not determine the constitutional status of a State or replace the Ministry of Finance as the borrowing authority.
accepted.tq: Apply the authority-function test by distinguishing implementation of sub-schemes from fiscal oversight.
accepted.sec: Measures taken - SPV route, releases, NITI Aayog and Finance Ministry roles

accepted.s: The Centre gave in-principle approval for the Rayalaseema Global Horticulture Hub with what proposed contribution pattern?
accepted.x: The proposed contribution for the Rayalaseema Global Horticulture Hub is ₹10,000 crore from the Centre and ₹30,000 crore from the State.
accepted.tq: Match each figure with the correct contributor instead of merely recalling the total scale of the project.
accepted.sec: Measures taken - SPV route, releases, NITI Aayog and Finance Ministry roles

accepted.s: Which one of the following combinations is correctly matched?
o: Rayalaseema Global Horticulture Hub — approximately ₹4,000 crore from UIDF
Visakhapatnam Economic Region — Centre's in-principle support
accepted.x: The Centre extended support for the Visakhapatnam Economic Region. Approximately ₹4,000 crore from the Urban Infrastructure Development Fund was separately associated with the measures, while Amaravati received ₹15,000 crore and Polavaram ₹12,157 crore as project grants.
accepted.tq: Separate the projects and their associated figures to avoid swapping neighbouring project details.
accepted.sec: Measures taken - SPV route, releases, NITI Aayog and Finance Ministry roles

accepted.s: Under the Centrally Sponsored Schemes (CSS) allocation for 2026–27, which of the following is correct?
accepted.x: For 2026–27, 86 CSS schemes were allocated ₹25,304 crore.
accepted.tq: Keep the scheme count and allocation together; the distractors swap figures from other programmes.

accepted.s: By 7 September 2026, what proportion of the funds allocated under the 2026–27 Centrally Sponsored Schemes had been used?
accepted.x: Only 47 per cent of the funds allocated under the CSS framework had been used by 7 September 2026.
accepted.tq: Use the exact percentage and date rather than confusing allocation with utilisation.

accepted.s: Which of the following is regarded as the principal criticism of the package provided in place of Special Category Status?
o: It provides only revenue grants and excludes capital works.
It consists entirely of automatic tax devolution without project conditions.
It is viewed as loans and projects in place of a status, with fund lapses and slow EAP approvals.
It abolishes all Central assistance to Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.x: The package has been criticised as a loans-and-projects arrangement instead of a status-based framework. Fund lapses and slow approvals for externally aided projects are also concerns.
accepted.tq: Find the option that combines the stated criticisms without reversing the nature of the package.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the present forms of special assistance to Andhra Pradesh:
1. SASCI is one of the principal forms of such assistance.
2. Project grants include ₹15,000 crore for Amaravati.
3. Project grants include ₹12,157 crore for Polavaram.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. SASCI and project grants have become the main forms of special help, including the specified grants for Amaravati and Polavaram.
accepted.tq: Check each programme and amount independently before selecting the complete coded combination.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly distinguishes Special Category Status from the package extended to Andhra Pradesh?
o: SCS is project-linked, whereas the package provides automatic 90:10 flows.
The package provides automatic 90:10 flows, whereas SCS is limited to capital works.
SCS provides status with automatic 90:10 flows, whereas the package provides equivalent money tied to projects.
Both SCS and the package provide identical untied grants without conditions.
accepted.x: Special Category Status carries automatic 90:10 flows. The alternative package is described as equivalent financial support tied to specific projects.
accepted.tq: Read the comparison in both directions and watch for the reversal of status-based and project-linked assistance.

accepted.s: The issue of Special Category Status versus the package influenced which political development in Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: The debate between Special Category Status and the package became an important part of the 2019 election narrative in Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Use the date-based political-context trap to distinguish the relevant election narrative.

accepted.s:
Assertion (A): The package for Andhra Pradesh has been criticised by some observers as inadequate compared with Special Category Status.
Reason (R): The package is viewed as providing loans and project-linked assistance instead of a status carrying automatic 90:10 flows.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
accepted.x: Both the Assertion and the Reason are true. The criticism follows from the difference between project-linked loans or assistance and the automatic 90:10 flows associated with Special Category Status.
accepted.tq: Test whether the stated distinction between status and package directly explains the criticism.
